summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; auth_type oauth and env-var refs in profile). Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and placed it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, selection, profile, override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed. Note: a sed edit changed the claim-test calls to a literal connection id string.
